text: You paid Meta to fill your fucking DMs, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Three hundred conversations started, bro. Look at that!
style: Hyped and proud, a casual American guy showing off his ad results to his buddy, pointing at a big screen.

text: Started, cool. How many got an answer?
style: Flat and deadpan, a beat after 'cool', then a trap question.
Smug and a little defensive, stressing 'literally', like it is obvious.

text: It counts people who messaged you after the ad. Not who got an answer.
style: Calm and sly, like revealing a secret, a small beat before the last sentence, then landing it hard.

text: Wait, so that's not three hundred leads?
style: Confused, the confidence draining out, rising at the end.

text: It's three hundred hellos. You paid Meta for a guestbook.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last word.

text: Lots of them click, say hi and ghost anyway.
style: Annoyed and defensive, shrugging it off.

text: Sure. The serious ones waited, then moved on to whoever answered first.
style: Suddenly dead serious, low and dramatic, slowing down on the last words.

text: Bro, I'm on calls all day. I can't live in my DMs.
style: Stressed and overwhelmed, a bit fast, like a tired confession.

text: You don't have to. Plug me into ManyChat. It keeps your ad trigger, and when they reply, I take over.
style: Smooth and confident, a beat after the first sentence, then an easy, assured offer.

text: And I don't sound like some bot?
You sound like you. One fit question at a time. Only the right ones get your calendar.
style: Calm and confident, rhythmic like a short checklist, a tiny beat between each sentence.

text: Okay. How do I set you up?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: First, stop presenting your hellos to an empty fucking boardroom.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
